# Member Appeal — Request for Reconsideration

**Date:** [Date you are mailing this letter]

**To:** Blue Cross & Blue Shield of Mississippi — Member Appeals
[Use the appeal address printed on my denial letter]

**From:**
Sawyer Carter
[My mailing address]
[My phone number]

**RE: Appeal of adverse benefit determination dated 2026-08-04**
- **Member:** Sawyer Carter
- **Member ID:** W602896534
- **Reference number:** POC-29630AA1D9-59024
- **Service denied:** Total ankle replacement, CPT 27702
- **Governing policy:** *Total Ankle Replacement, Policy L.7.01.428* — https://www.bcbsms.com/policy-search/medical/policy-detail/total-ankle-replacement

---

## What I am asking for

I am appealing the denial of prior authorization for my total ankle replacement (CPT 27702), which Blue Cross & Blue Shield of Mississippi denied on 2026-08-04. I am asking the plan to reconsider that decision and approve the surgery my orthopedic surgeon, Dr. Reyes, has documented that I need.

The notice states that the records submitted do not document an adequate trial of conservative treatment before surgery. I am writing because my records do document conservative treatment, and because the policy language I have been able to review does not set out the conservative-care requirement the denial relies on.

## The plan's own policy language, and what my records show

The plan's medical policy states:

> "BCBSMS makes no payment for services, treatments, procedures, equipment, drugs, devices, items or supplies which are not documented to be Medically Necessary."

The same policy also states:

> "Total ankle replacement using an FDA-approved device may be considered medically necessary in skeletally mature patients with moderate to severe ankle (tibiotalar) pain that limits daily activity"

My records address that standard directly:

- **Ankle (tibiotalar) pain:** I have had 24 months of progressive pain in the ankle, unrelieved by rest.
- **Pain that limits daily activity:** I walk with an antalgic gait and am limited to two blocks. On examination, my range of motion is limited by pain, with positive provocative testing on the affected side.
- **Objective imaging of the tibiotalar joint:** Weight-bearing ankle radiographs taken 2026-06-20 show tibiotalar joint space obliteration with subchondral cysts.

The policy also states, as patient selection guidance:

> "Patients should have no functional barriers to participation in a rehabilitation program"

I completed 18 visits of supervised physical therapy over 12 weeks, from 2026-04-08 to 2026-07-01, focused on ankle strengthening and balance, as documented in my physical therapy discharge note. Completing that full course of therapy shows I am able to participate in a rehabilitation program. I also have no active infection, no untreated substance use, a BMI of 29, and I do not smoke.

The policy further states:

> "The following Guideline may be used for Patient Selection Criteria: Optimal Candidates Older (age >50) Thin Low-demand individuals with minimal deformity"

and defines Medically Necessary care as, among other things, care that is:

> "consistent with the symptoms or diagnosis and treatment of the Member's condition, illness, or injury; and B. appropriate with regard to standards of good medical practice; and C. not solely for the convenience of the Member, his or her Provider; and D. the most appropriate supply or level of care which can safely be provided to Member."

The surgery is consistent with my documented symptoms and imaging findings, it is recommended by my treating orthopedic surgeon rather than requested for anyone's convenience, and it is being considered only after other treatments were tried and did not hold.

## About the stated reason for the denial

The reason given for the denial is that the records do not document an adequate trial of conservative treatment. My records document the following conservative care before surgery was requested:

- **Physical therapy:** 12 weeks of supervised physical therapy, 2026-04-08 to 2026-07-01, 18 visits completed, documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- **Medication:** NSAIDs for 6 months, with inadequate relief.
- **Injection:** a corticosteroid injection on 2026-04-13, which gave 4 weeks of partial relief.
- **Time:** 24 months of progressive pain unrelieved by rest.

I want to be straightforward with the reviewer about one point: the policy language I have been able to review, quoted above, is the only plan text I am working from, and **none of it states a conservative-care requirement, a required duration, or a required number of treatments.** I am therefore not quoting any such rule to the plan, because I have not been shown one. I also recognize that some of the policy text I have introduces lists of further conditions that were not reproduced in what I received.

Because of that, I am asking the plan to identify, in writing, the specific criterion it applied in denying my request — including the exact conservative-care requirement and any threshold it believes I did not meet — and to show how my documented 12 weeks of physical therapy, 6 months of NSAIDs, and corticosteroid injection fall short of it. If the plan applied a standard that is not in the policy quoted above, I ask that the denial be reconsidered on that basis.

## What I am requesting

Please overturn the denial dated 2026-08-04 and authorize the total ankle replacement, CPT 27702, as recommended by Dr. Reyes.

If the plan maintains the denial, I ask that it provide:

1. The specific policy criterion, quoted in full, that my request was found not to meet;
2. A copy of all criteria used in this review; and
3. Information about my further appeal rights, including any external review.

I am submitting this appeal within the 180-day period stated in my denial notice, which requires that my appeal be received by **2027-01-31**. I am sending it to the appeal address printed on my denial letter; if that address has changed, I will call the number on the back of my insurance card to confirm where member appeals are filed.

**Enclosed for review:**
- Copy of the denial notice dated 2026-08-04 (reference POC-29630AA1D9-59024)
- Physical therapy discharge note covering 2026-04-08 to 2026-07-01
- Weight-bearing ankle radiograph report dated 2026-06-20
- Office notes from Dr. Reyes, orthopedic surgery
- [Any other records you wish to enclose]

Thank you for taking another look at this. I would appreciate a written decision as soon as the plan is able to provide one.

Sincerely,

**Sawyer Carter**
Member ID: W602896534
[Signature]
[Date signed]
[Phone number]
[Email address, if you wish to provide one]

---

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
